neighbours.label: Comparing a real scene or life to fiction, legend or dream: 'like something out of a ___', 'the stuff of ___', 'as if from a storybook', 'could not believe my eyes'
fire: The old harbour looks like a scene lifted straight from a pirate film.
Their comeback from three goals down was the kind of thing you only see in movies.
With its turrets and ivy, the house could have come out of a fairy tale.
The whole evening felt like a dream, as if none of it had really happened.
Walking the empty streets at dawn was like stepping into a storybook.
The valley was so green that I had to pinch myself to believe it was real.
His account of the escape sounds like the plot of a spy novel.
The ballroom looked as though it had been painted by a set designer for a period drama.
quiet: The old harbour was dredged last year to make room for larger ferries.
Their comeback from three goals down earned them a place in the semi-final.
With its turrets and ivy, the house needs a new roof before winter.
The whole evening was spent sorting receipts for the tax return.
Walking the empty streets at dawn, she took the keys out of her bag.
The valley was so green that the farmers cut a second crop of hay.
His account of the escape was taken down by two officers at the station.
The ballroom was repainted in cream and the floor was sanded.

predictions: Unreal-comparison frames reach 0.5-1.1, peaking on the preposition before the fiction noun; literal 'out of', 'stuff' as material, and plain descriptions of the same scenes stay under 0.1. The frame 'the stuff of' fires even before a mundane noun (probe 0.596), so no near miss uses it.
notes: Probe: 'out of a magazine spread' 1.125 (peak ' a'), 'the stuff of science fiction' 0.950, 'something out of a child's painting' 0.937, 'the stuff of legends' 0.915, 'was a story someone told me' 0.609, Chinese 无法相信自己的眼睛 0.714; 'the stuff of the report' 0.596 leaks (the frame predicts a legend noun); 'keys out of a drawer' 0.008, 'cottages were painted white' 0.017. The + pole's output suppresses ' dream', ' reality', ' surreal', ' fiction', ' myth', so this pole promotes them.
